title: Xiaomi Gaming Monitor G24i 180Hz Review: A Great-Value Gaming Monitor for eSports Players
summary: The Xiaomi Gaming Monitor G24i ELA5625EU is a 24-inch gaming monitor that stands out with a 180Hz refresh rate and 1ms response time. It is an attractive choice for FPS and eSports players who want smooth gameplay at a reasonable cost.
description:
## Who is it for?

- Valorant players.
- Counter-Strike 2 players.
- Apex Legends players.
- League of Legends players.
- Students who want a great-value gaming monitor.
- Anyone upgrading from a 60Hz or 75Hz monitor.

## Why buy it?

- 180Hz gives a clear edge in competitive games.
- 1ms reduces latency and ghosting.
- Attractive price for the performance you get.
- Good-looking design that fits many setups.
- Xiaomi is increasingly well regarded for monitors.

sections.title: Minimal but effective design
sections.content: The Xiaomi Gaming Monitor G24i has a modern style with thin bezels and a clean look. It suits both a gaming corner and a regular workspace.

sections.title: What difference does 180Hz make?
sections.content: A 180Hz refresh rate makes motion much smoother than on 60Hz or 75Hz monitors. In FPS games, you can track moving targets more easily and react faster.

sections.title: 1ms response time for competitive players
sections.content: A 1ms response time reduces ghosting and blur during fast motion — especially important for eSports players.

sections.title: Everyday experience
sections.content: Beyond gaming, the monitor handles study, office work, movies and entertainment well. Many people find 24 inches a good balance between performance and desk space.

sections.title: Should you buy the Xiaomi Gaming Monitor G24i?
sections.content: If you want a fast gaming monitor on a sensible budget, the Xiaomi G24i is one of the standout choices in the lower mid-range today.

pros: 180Hz refresh rate delivers an extremely smooth experience.
Well suited to FPS and eSports titles.
Modern, minimal design typical of Xiaomi.
Competitive price in the gaming segment.
Better gaming performance than many rivals at the same price.
cons: Full HD is not ideal for those who want a sharper picture.
Lacks premium features such as USB-C or strong HDR.
Not aimed at professional graphic design work.
buying_advice: Highly recommended for eSports players and anyone upgrading to a high-refresh-rate monitor.

faq.question: Is the Xiaomi Gaming Monitor G24i good for Valorant?
faq.answer: Yes. The 180Hz refresh rate and 1ms response time make it especially well suited to FPS games like Valorant.

faq.question: Is 180Hz very different from 144Hz?
faq.answer: It is smoother, but not dramatically so. For competitive players, though, 180Hz still gives a certain edge.

faq.question: Is this monitor suitable for study and work?
faq.answer: Yes. Beyond gaming, it handles office work, studying and everyday entertainment well.
